positive_control.sample_source: semgrep's documented --json shape. The registry run produced no findings at all, so there is no real finding of semgrep's own to copy; the envelope is semgrep's and the rule id is a placeholder, which is stated here rather than implied.

measurements.note: 0 findings under --config auto, p/rust and p/security-audit. The registry has no rules aimed at the Solana account-validation family this corpus tests. That is a fact about the registry and it remains true; the SOL-0XX pack row measures the other question. No per-run log.
